artworks.description: This is a painting depicting a heraldic coat of arms. The image features a detailed coat of arms with a central shield, adorned with black and gold sections, and additional decorative elements above it. There is a figure resembling a unicorn emerging from the crest. The background is a deep red hue. The artwork is displayed within a wooden frame with crossbars. This style is associated with displaying family crests and lineage.

artworks.dimensions:

artworks.description: Shown from the waist up, a light-skinned woman sits angled slightly to our right in this vertical portrait painting. The woman has blue eyes, faint brows, and a sloping nose ending in a small bulb. Her upper lip is thin and her lower lip full over a slight double chin. Her blond hair is pulled back under a gold, cap-like headdress and a black, wide-brimmed hat with a shallow crown. She wears a high-necked white, black, and gold dress with intricate detailing, a gold chain necklace that falls to her waist, and a black belt with a gold clasp and medallions. She wears two gold rings set with gems on the pointer finger of her left hand, which is folded across her belly over the other hand. A scarlet-red wallcovering with pink floral designs fills two-thirds of the space behind her. The rightmost third of the background opens onto a landscape with a tall, spindly tree, a leaping animal, presumably a dog, and a bridge across a body of water leading to a town. Across another body of water, perhaps a lake, mountains are marine blue in the distance under a clear, celestial-blue sky.

artworks.description: The image shows a pattern of vertical and horizontal wooden bars forming a grid-like design. In the center, there is a rectangular panel with a decorative emblem against a red background. The emblem features swirling shapes. The structured wooden grid and ornate emblem suggest a vintage heraldic shield or coat of arms.

artworks.title: The Madonna of the Stars
artworks.description: Shown from the knees up, a seated woman is surrounded by an arch of disembodied, winged baby heads as she gazes down at an infant lying across her lap in this vertical painting. They all have pale, peachy skin, and are placed against a honey-gold background. The floating heads are all angled inward to face the woman. The woman sits on straw-yellow clouds that billow up from the lower right corner, and more clouds fill the upper corners around the floating heads. The woman and baby take up most of the canvas. The woman’s knees are angled to our left but her upper body turns to us. Her hands are together, fingertips touching and coming toward us. Her chestnut-brown hair is pulled back and gathered at the back of her head, and is covered by a translucent white veil that falls to her shoulders. Her shoulders and upper arms are wrapped in an ivory-white shawl over a fawn-brown dress with rose-pink sleeves. Pale yellow stars create a ring around her head, which tilts down as she gazes toward the child with large brown eyes. The plump baby lies on his back, with his head resting on the woman’s right leg, farther from us. He has short, brown hair with dark eyes looking straight up. The white cloth on which he lies wraps around his midsection and upper thighs. One hand rests on his belly and the other by his side, and his chubby knees are bent over the woman’s leg.

artworks.title: Ann Old Coleman (Mrs. Robert Coleman)
artworks.medium: oil on canvas transferred to wood
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a seated woman facing forward. She has her hands clasped together in front of her. The woman appears calm with visible signs of age, including a few wrinkles on her face. She wears a white bonnet with a frilled edge tied under her chin, a dark shawl over a white high-collared blouse, and sits on a red chair with a gold trim. A red book and a handkerchief are on the surface next to her. The background transitions from deep red to brown tones.

artworks.title: Robert Coleman
artworks.medium: oil on canvas transferred to wood
artworks.description: The image shows a man sitting and facing the viewer. He has his right hand on a table. The man's hair is gray and neatly styled. He is wearing a dark coat with a high collar, a white shirt, and a yellow vest peeking through. On the table are a quill, inkwell, and papers. The background is a dark, neutral tone.

artworks.title: The Coleman Sisters
artworks.description: In this painting, three women are depicted standing and sitting closely together. The women have fair complexions and dark hair in ringlets, and they are smiling slightly. The woman on the left appears to be standing, and her body is turned to the right while her head is turned over her shoulder to face us. She wears a light blue dress with a brown shawl, and she is holding the edge of a red book that rests on a small table in the bottom right corner. The woman in the middle also appears to be standing, and she is wearing a golden-yellow off-the-shoulder garment. One of her hands is on the shoulder of the woman on the left. The woman on the right is seated at the small table, and she wears a pale pink off-the-shoulder dress. She looks directly out at us. The small table is covered in a golden cloth, and on the right is a vase of colorful flowers. The wall behind the woman is a blend of brown, tan, and pale blue tones.

artworks.title: Hound and Hunter
artworks.description: A young man with a peachy, ruddy complexion lies on his stomach in a wooden rowboat on a river, reaching forward to grasp the horn of a stag almost completely submerged in the rippling water with one hand. On the opposite riverbank, gold, rust, and scarlet-red trees span the width of this horizontal painting. The boy’s arms straddle the stern of the boat so one holds the antler with his right hand, closer to us, while the other clutches a rope with a loop at the end. He turns his face, mouth agape and cheeks flushed, over his right shoulder to look to our left, at a dog swimming toward the boat. The dog has white and caramel-brown markings, with dark brown ears. The boy wears earth-brown clothing and the front of his wide-brimmed hat is pushed up to reveal dark eyes and sable-brown bangs and brows. The stag and dog are between us and the boat, and are surrounded by thick brushstrokes of parchment white to create ripples in the forest-green water. Only the open muzzle, part of the eye, and the tips of the stag’s antlers are above the water’s surface. To our right, a bare, fallen tree lies along the far riverbank parallel to the boat. The boat and water fill the lower half of the scene and the autumn trees fill the upper half. The artist has signed and dated the painting in the lower right, “Winslow Homer 1892.”

artworks.title: Henri II de Lorraine
artworks.description: A man with pale skin, wearing a gold-embroidered amber-yellow jacket and tomato-red pants, stands in front of a rocky outcropping with a distant view beyond in this vertical portrait painting. At the center of the composition and taking up most of it, the man stands with his body facing us, but he turns his head slightly to our left and looks off in that direction with slate-blue eyes under curving brows. His smooth cheeks are lightly flushed in his oval face. His full pink lips are closed and are framed by a mustache and small, pointed goatee under his lower lip. His wavy brown hair falls in bangs across his forehead and down to his shoulders. One longer lock has been braided and tied with a yellow and red bow, which rests on the front of his left shoulder, to our right. A wide, lace collar extends from his neck to drape over his shoulders, overlapping a piece of metal armor around the neck, called a gorget. His yellow jacket, a doublet, is embroidered with gold along the hems and where it hangs open down the front to show a white shirt beneath. The silver sleeve we can see is cut with a long slit along the forearm to also show the white linen beneath, and both cuffs have layers of lace at the wrists. A crimson-red coat or cape hangs over his left arm, on our right. His red pants are covered all over with gold stitching above ivory-white, calf-high boots. He holds a wide-brimmed, black hat adorned with plumes of red, white, and marigold-orange feathers in his right hand, on our left. An armored breastplate rests at his feet. He stands on a dirt ground with a tall boulder immediately behind him to our right. The landscape in the distance to our left has a sky filled with steel-gray clouds above trees and hills.

artworks.title: The Death of the Earl of Chatham
artworks.description: This is a painting of a large gathering in a grand hall or courtroom setting. Filling the space are numerous people dressed in elaborate robes. These people all appear to be men with pale skin and curled white hair. Light streams down from a round window near the top left corner, casting a dramatic light on a group of men gathered to the right of center. One man in this group appears to have fainted, and the others are gathered around him, supporting his head and limbs. The other men in the room look to the right, towards this group. The room contains several ornate architectural elements, like a high curved ceiling with recessed areas, draping fabric along the wall near the top right corner, and a tapestry below the window on the left. The color palette is entirely in shades of pale yellow, brown, cream, white, and gray.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Young Lady
artworks.description: This painting shows a woman standing next to a tree, her left arm resting on a low branch. She has fair skin, rosy cheeks, large eyes, and dark curled hair in an updo and adorned with a pink flower. She wears a dress with a red-and-green floral pattern on a pale-yellow background, puffed sleeves, a lacy collar, and a wide belt. She is holding a closed green umbrella in her right hand. A pale-yellow hat with a veil rests on the ground behind her to the left. She stands on a brown patch of dirt, and to the right appears to be a body of water with green reeds. The background shows dense green trees under a sky of pastel pink clouds, a small patch of blue visible near the top left.

artworks.title: Gouverneur Kemble
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a seated man. He is positioned slightly angled to the right and looking directly at the viewer. The man has a stern expression, characterized by his prominent brow and deep-set eyes. His hair is light brown with some natural curl, extending just below his ears. He is dressed in formal attire, including a dark coat, a cream-colored waistcoat, a white shirt, and a black cravat. His hands rest on his lap, one hand holding a pair of spectacles. A gold chain hangs from a pocket of his waistcoat. The background is a dark, muted shade that contrasts with the warm tones of the chair and his clothing.

artworks.title: William Clark Frazer
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man, facing forward with his head slightly turned to his right. He has a stern expression, fair complexion, and short dark hair with a receding hairline. He is wearing a white high-collared shirt with a cravat, and a dark coat with a noticeable collar and buttons. The background is a simple dark backdrop.

artworks.title: James P. Smith
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated, turned slightly to the left, looking directly at the viewer. He has fair skin, light-colored eyes, and dark brown wavy hair with sideburns reaching his jawline. He wears a black coat with a high collar over a white shirt. He sits near an easel with a sketch visible, holding a palette and paintbrushes in his left hand. The background has draped fabric in red or brown shades.

artworks.title: William Sidney Mount
artworks.description: The image shows a person from the waist up, in a seated position with the body slightly angled to the right while the head is turned towards the left. The person has light skin, brown hair that is parted in the middle, and falls to just below the ears, with a distinctive full mustache and beard along the jawline. The person is dressed in a dark jacket over a vibrant red vest and a high-collared blue shirt or tie is visible. A small pin adorns the blue fabric. The background is a textured mix of warm brown tones.

artworks.title: Henry Theodore Tuckerman
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man shown from the shoulders upward. He is in a side profile facing to his right. The man has a full beard and mustache, brown, slightly curly hair, a broad forehead, and deep-set eyes. He wears a dark jacket, white shirt, and a black bow tie. The background is a blend of brown and grey tones.

artworks.title: George Pope Morris
artworks.description: The image shows a man's upper body in a formal portrait setting. He is depicted sitting or standing upright with his head turned slightly to the right, directly facing the viewer. The man has fair skin, distinct facial features including a full face with a slight smile and prominent cheeks. His hair is dark, thick, and curly, framing his face neatly. He is dressed in formal attire, wearing a dark coat and a white shirt with a high collar, complemented by a black bow tie. There is a hint of a gold chain peeking from beneath his coat. The background is a plain, dark brown.

artworks.title: Charles Loring Elliott
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man shown from the torso up. He is positioned slightly turned to the right, facing the viewer with a direct gaze. He has a balding forehead with thin hair at the top, and the remaining hair is long and curly at the sides and back. His facial features include a prominent nose and a full, white beard and mustache that cover most of his lower face. The man is dressed in a dark, subdued garment with a high collar visible around his neck. The background is plain and dark, with subtle variations in color, keeping the focus on the subject. There are no visible jewelry or objects being held.

artworks.title: Mr. Motte
artworks.description: The image shows an upper-body portrait of a man facing forward with his body tilted slightly to the left. He wears a brown coat over a teal waistcoat and a white ruffled shirt is visible at the cuffs and neckline. The man has high cheekbones, a straight nose, and a serious expression. His dark hair is styled in large, slightly curled side parts. The man is set against a plain, muted green background, emphasizing the subject of the portrait.

artworks.title: John Sudam
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up, seated in a slightly turned position with his right shoulder facing the viewer. He has a square jawline, prominent cheekbones, and dark, curly hair. He is wearing a black coat, a white cravat, and a white shirt. He has sideburns and his left hand is resting on an unseen object, possibly a book. The background is dark with a subdued gradient.
